provenance.note: an empty value from a bool flag's source is written through f.Set with the error discarded, so a validator that rejects the value never fails the flag; the base and the reviewed head behave identically on this path (both run with the validator's rejection ignored), so the PR neither introduces nor repairs this defect, and the later fix propagates the error instead

bugs.note: the else branch of the reviewed empty-value handling calls f.Set(f.Name, "false") as `_ = f.Set(...)`, discarding both the parse error and the validator error; the fix rewrites the branch to set val = "false" and return the error
